body:
### Consequences & Impact
**Risk:** Blast-radius risk with raw SQL mutations (e.g. crowdfund pledge/refund in `db.ts`). The FORFEIT resolution protects all ledger-mediated operations (`transfer`, `moveToCommons`, `payFromCommons`), but raw SQL updates in `db.ts` mutate `accounts.balance` directly in SQLite. 

When `reconcileLedgerFromDb()` runs after a raw SQL balance update, `loadState()` loads the newly modified balance along with the *old, stored `last_demurrage_epoch`* from SQLite. If `getAccount()` was not called prior to the raw SQL `UPDATE`, the stored epoch remains stale while the principal balance increases. On the next ledger read, `applyDecay()` will calculate demurrage on the newly enlarged balance against the old epoch window.

**Suggested Fix:**
In `apps/server/src/db/db.ts` (e.g., pledge/refund functions), before running raw `UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + ?` queries, call `ledger.getAccount(pubkey)` first to settle and close any pending demurrage interval, and update `last_demurrage_epoch = currentEpoch` in the SQL `UPDATE` statement so the new principal balance is isolated from the old time window.
